review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read the test file RingedSpacesTests/CompatibleAtlases.lean, which is the only user of these simp lemmas, and grepped for other uses. I found no other uses of the two chartAt lemmas. I did not run Lean, so the shadowing claim below follows from simp's inside-out rewriting order and is not an observed failure. The other simp lemmas (identityDiffeomorph_apply, _apply_down, _symm_apply) are rfl-style evaluation lemmas that look orientation-correct. identityDiffeomorph_apply_down may be partly redundant with identityDiffeomorph_apply plus ULift.up_down. I could not confirm whether ULift.up_down is a simp lemma, so I did not report that. mem_liftedChartedSpace_atlas_iff is reasonably left non-simp.

findings.excerpt:
theorem liftedChartedSpace_chartAt_apply (C : ChartedSpace H M) (x y : M) :
    (@chartAt H _ (ULift.{v} M) _ (liftedChartedSpace C) (ULift.up x)) (ULift.up y) =
      C.chartAt x y := by
  simp [liftedChartedSpace_chartAt, Homeomorph.ulift]
findings.problem: Two @[simp] lemmas compete on the same term. The earlier @[simp] lemma liftedChartedSpace_chartAt rewrites the inner term `chartAt (liftedChartedSpace C) z` for any `z`. Simp rewrites subterms before the enclosing application. So in `chartAt (ULift.up x) (ULift.up y)`, the inner `chartAt ... (ULift.up x)` should be rewritten first, to `(Homeomorph.ulift ...).toOpenPartialHomeomorph ≫ₕ C.chartAt (ULift.up x).down`. The pointwise lemma, whose LHS needs the original `chartAt ... (ULift.up x)` as its function head, then probably cannot fire from simp. Its own proof also has to unfold `liftedChartedSpace_chartAt` and `Homeomorph.ulift` by hand. The only use, in the test file, calls it with `rw` rather than `simp`, which is consistent with this. As written, it is an @[simp] lemma that simp is unlikely to use. Users of simp get a trans/ULift.down expression instead of the intended normal form `C.chartAt x y`.
findings.proposed_change: Choose one canonical normal form. If `C.chartAt x y` is the intended normal form for evaluation, state the pointwise lemma in a way that simp can reach it: either drop @[simp] from `liftedChartedSpace_chartAt` and keep it as a plain unfolding lemma, or add a simp lemma for the composite `((Homeomorph.ulift).toOpenPartialHomeomorph ≫ₕ f) (ULift.up y) = f y` so the expanded form also reduces to `C.chartAt x y`. Alternatively, remove @[simp] from the `_apply` lemma and keep it for `rw`, as the test does. Then check with `simp` on the example in RingedSpacesTests/CompatibleAtlases.lean that the chosen form is reached.
findings.benefit: Simp has one predictable normal form for charts of the lifted charted space. The simp set no longer contains a lemma that is shadowed by another. Downstream goals such as the test example no longer need a manual `rw`.

evidence.excerpt:
@chartAt H _ (ULift.{v} M) _ (liftedChartedSpace C) x =
      (Homeomorph.ulift : ULift.{v} M ≃ₜ M).toOpenPartialHomeomorph ≫ₕ C.chartAt x.down
